about.lead: Green Net Power is a power systems engineering and consulting firm. Our work spans power flow, short-circuit, and transient stability studies; transmission planning; renewable energy feasibility; microgrid design; and power quality mitigation.
about.history: Since 2004, we have developed and delivered an automated and coordinated control system for FACTS devices (UPFC) to KEPCO Research Institute, participated in a government-funded R&D program on coordinated STATCOM control, and conducted feasibility studies for 220 kV transmission lines in Mozambique and island microgrids in Ethiopia and the Philippines. More recent assignments cover transmission constraint mitigation in Korea, power system reinforcement advisory in Oman, transmission and substation planning in Paraguay, and an electricity tariff negotiation framework for Ethiopia.
about.principle: Every engagement is grounded in power system studies. We quantify the client’s technical challenge and present practical alternatives supported by engineering data—a principle that has guided our work for more than 20 years.

services.title: What We Do
services.powerTitle: Power System Studies, Grid Planning & Markets
services.powerDescription: We apply power system studies to national grid planning, transmission investment decisions, and electricity market advisory assignments.
services.powerItem1: Transmission feasibility studies and assessments of shared network use
services.powerItem2: Review of generation plans, transmission plans, and demand forecasts
services.powerItem3: Transmission constraint mitigation and network reinforcement options
services.powerItem4: Electricity tariff frameworks and cross-border power trade arrangements
services.renewablesDescription: We support the full lifecycle of off-grid and island power projects, from demand assessment and system optimization through construction oversight, commissioning, and operations planning.
services.renewablesItem1: Optimized solar PV, battery energy storage, and generator systems for islands and remote communities
services.renewablesItem2: Community-scale clean energy feasibility studies and construction management
services.renewablesItem3: Technical advisory for ADB and other international programs
services.qualityDescription: We assess how voltage sags and other power quality disturbances affect equipment and industrial processes, then develop site-specific mitigation measures.
services.qualityItem1: Power quality assessments and voltage-sag mitigation design
services.qualityItem2: Protection of semiconductor, precision manufacturing, and other sensitive process loads
services.qualityItem3: FACTS control applications, including STATCOM and UPFC
services.trainingDescription: We develop scaled laboratory systems for power networks and renewable energy applications and provide client-specific technical training.
services.trainingItem1: Microgrid design and operation laboratory platforms
services.trainingItem2: Grid operation, SCADA/EMS, and FACTS training systems
services.trainingItem3: Laboratory equipment for universities and technical training institutes

projects.title: Selected Experience
projects.intro: Selected assignments delivered for clients in Korea and abroad, from KEPCO R&D systems to national power-sector advisory programs.
projects.paraguayDescription: Technical advisory supporting Paraguay’s national transmission and substation planning, covering power system studies, generation and network development plans, and demand forecasts to identify cost-effective options.
projects.ethiopiaTariffTitle: Development of an Ethiopian Electricity Tariff Negotiation Framework
projects.ethiopiaTariffDescription: Development of a standardized framework for electricity tariff negotiations, covering domestic tariff structures and cross-border power trade.
projects.omanDescription: Review of Oman’s power system, generation and transmission development plans, and demand forecasts, with recommendations suited to local power-sector conditions.
projects.koreaTitle: East Coast Transmission Constraint Mitigation, Korea
projects.koreaDescription: Completed an East Coast transmission constraint mitigation study (2023), an assessment of shared use for the Anin Unit 2 transmission line (2023), and a 154 kV transmission-cable slippage assessment (2024).
projects.mozambiqueTitle: Mozambique 220 kV Transmission Line Feasibility Studies
projects.mozambiqueDescription: Technical feasibility studies for the Namialo–Metoro (2015–16) and Metoro–Palma (2018) sections of Mozambique’s 220 kV transmission network.
projects.ethiopiaDescription: Feasibility study and construction management for an off-grid hybrid power system combining 250 kW of solar PV, 1,000 kWh of battery storage, and biomass and biodiesel generation.
projects.philippinesDescription: Technical advisory for the Logbon (Cobrador) Island solar-hybrid feasibility study and expansion planning, including work under ADB Mini-Grid Subproject A.
projects.factsTitle: Automated & Coordinated Control System for FACTS (UPFC)
projects.factsDescription: Developed and delivered a SCADA-integrated optimal operation and control system for the UPFC at Gangjin Substation to KEPCO Research Institute. Also contributed to a government-funded R&D program on coordinated control of a 100 MVA-class STATCOM, including operation on the KEPCO grid at Migeum Substation.
